data.name: Mriganka
data.gender_notes: Mriganka is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mriganka is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mrig', meaning a deer. In Hindu mythology, Mriganka represents beauty, grace, and agility. It is also a symbol of strength and resilience, as a deer is known for its ability to leap over obstacles and protect its young. The name Mriganka carries the meaning “Beautiful deer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mriganka usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful deer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the grace and resilience of a deer, and let your spirit soar like the wind through the forest.
